---
title: Rationale
acronyms:
  insert_loa: false
---

The choice of predicting taxi-out time is in line with past data challenges
goals of providing information to estimate environmental or operational impact.
Taxi-out time is generally difficult to obtain and quite difficult to predict.

A model to infer taxi-out can be used in post-ops analysis to measure
excess fuel burnt/CO2 production compared to unconstrained operations.

The reasons for variability of taxi-out time are various and interlinked.
Taxi-out time can depend on airline specific constraints, airport procedures
and load, \acr{ATFM} related reasons.
